description: Embark on a giant kingdom-building adventure journeying to exotic lands and helping your new, tiny Kefling friends along the way in A World of Keflings! Play as your Xbox LIVE Avatar and help the friendly, little Keflings harvest resources, assemble buildings and create thriving cities in desert, forest and ice kingdoms. Mine stone and crystal, harvest lumber and wool, and craft elaborate buildings. Have fun creating and customizing beautiful cities filled with fountains, workshops, castles and more!
